svg.title: Pundoku wordmark — D1 «Створ»
svg.desc: Drawn letterforms, not a font: monolinear geometric construction, stroke 22 on a cap height of 104 and an x-height of 76. No glyph from any typeface is embedded, so there is no font licence to clear. The o of "doku" is built as the aperture cell — use this standalone version only when the mark is NOT also present in the lockup (branding.md: a logo should not repeat itself).
